cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 ties the taxpayer number to the national ID. The computerised register rests on the DGI's October 2023 FAQ alone.
cells.note: The IFU is issued from the DGI's register (BFA-001, 2023) and, per CEFORE in November 2026, obtained at business registration (BFA-003), as customs already required it (BFA-002). Nothing ties it to the national ID, so not 5.
